sentences.text: The petitioner herein is the driver-cum-owner of Indica car bearing the registration plate No.PB-48C-4273, which is alleged to have been involved in an automobile accident resulting in death of late Sh. Satish Kumar.

The claimants have filed a claim petition under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, for grant of compensation, which is pending before the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (hereinafter referred to as the 'Tribunal').
The petitioner herein is aggrieved of the order passed by the Tribunal closing his evidence.
The Court has closed the evidence on the ground that as many as 18 opportunities have already been granted to the petitioner to produce the evidence.
2. This Bench has heard the learned counsel representing the parties at length and with their able assistance perused the paperbook.

opennyai_summary.facts:
The petitioner herein is the driver-cum-owner of Indica car bearing the registration plate No.PB-48C-4273, which is alleged to have been involved in an automobile accident resulting in death of late Sh. Satish Kumar.
The claimants have filed a claim petition under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, for grant of compensation, which is pending before the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (hereinafter referred to as the 'Tribunal').
It is evident that the petitioners have been making all efforts to produce evidence to prove that the vehicle was insured with the Oriental Insurance Company.
opennyai_summary.arguments:
The petitioner herein is aggrieved of the order passed by the Tribunal closing his evidence.
The Court has closed the evidence on the ground that as many as 18 opportunities have already been granted to the petitioner to produce the evidence.
He submits that the aforesaid proposal form is now in the custody of the I.T. Department located in the Head Office of the Oriental Insurance Company.

Last opportunity is extended till then.
7. Keeping in view the aforesaid facts, the revision petition is allowed.

9. All the pending miscellaneous applications, if any, are also disposed of.
